summary: Improve the existing Smart Salon landing page to look modern, clean, and premium (dark theme with gold accents), focusing only on booking/scheduling/management; remove all rewards/coins/gamification references; do not reuse the previously provided paragraph and instead write new short clean website copy; ensure correct use of the provided logo in the header; refine spacing/alignment/typography; include a clean mobile app preview in the hero; update features to 3–4 cards including Service Discovery; keep mobile responsiveness and minimal layout. Additionally, update footer Contact details (email + phone) and create new Privacy Policy and Terms content/pages (Privacy Policy inspired by the shared page, Terms drafted appropriately). Domain direction updated: user selected custom domain "smartsalonapp.com" (instead of smartsalon.com) for a public, app-friendly URL. Add a new section to the landing page titled "About App" with the exact provided text describing Smart Salon as a modern salon booking and management app for customers and salon owners.
architectural_notes: Layout: use 80% centered content width (not full-bleed) to keep content in the middle.
Grid: set column gutters to 2.5 to increase spacing between columns.
Alignment: set icon/feature card alignment to Top so icons align in one line across cards.
Typography: reduce description font size slightly to avoid text feeling “squeezed”.
Theme tokens: bg #0B0F19, accent #D4AF37, headings #FFFFFF, body text #B0B3B8; modern sans-serif; rounded cards + subtle shadows; mobile responsive.
Content: use the user-provided short app description for About copy and/or SEO meta description.
Links: Privacy Policy should point to https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Qudsiya-khan-dot/smart-salon-privacy-policy/refs/heads/main/README.md
Content: remove any coins/rewards/gamification messaging; keep scope limited to booking, scheduling, and management.
Copy: do not reuse the previously provided paragraph verbatim; write new short, clean landing-page copy.
Branding: use the provided app logo (no replacements); keep it sharp, undistorted, with proper padding/spacing in the header.

existing_features.title: Create a single-page, modern, premium landing page for the mobile app named “Smart Salon” with a dark luxury theme and a minimal, elegant, centered layout.

Implement global layout rules for the landing page: set the main content container to 80% width (not full-bleed) and centered; increase inter-column spacing (gutters) to 2.5 units; use top alignment for icon+text blocks so icons sit on a consistent horizontal line; make feature/description text slightly smaller so it does not feel squeezed.

Build the Hero section with the exact copy and CTAs: Headline “Book Your Salon Appointments Anytime”, subtext “Easy booking, rewards, and complete salon management in one app”, primary button “Get Started”, secondary button “View Features”.
Build the About section with the exact copy: Headline “All in One Salon Booking App” and the provided paragraph describing customers and salon owners.

Build the Features section with headline and subtext, and include 4 feature cards with icons and the exact titles/descriptions: Smart Booking, Coins Rewards, Owner Dashboard, Easy Management. Ensure the icons and text are top-aligned and cards use rounded corners with subtle shadows.
Build the How It Works section with headline “Simple Steps” and three steps using the exact step titles and descriptions: Step 1 Search Salon, Step 2 Book Appointment, Step 3 Earn Rewards.
Build the Benefits section with headline “Built for Customers and Owners” and the provided bullet points.

Build the App Screens section with headline “See How It Works” and subtext “A simple and powerful interface”, and include a responsive layout placeholder area for 3 to 5 mobile app screenshots (no functional carousel required unless already available in the template).
Build the Footer with text “All rights reserved” and links labeled “Privacy Policy”, “Terms”, and “Contact”.

Apply the specified design tokens consistently across the landing page: background #0B0F19, gold accent #D4AF37, headings #FFFFFF, paragraph text #B0B3B8; use clean modern UI elements, rounded cards, subtle shadows, and ensure the entire page is mobile responsive.
Update the About section paragraph copy to use the user-provided short description exactly as provided (English), replacing the current shorter sentence.
Set the Footer “Privacy Policy” link to point to the provided URL and open in a new tab with safe rel attributes.

Replace the App Screens section placeholder cards with the user-uploaded app screenshots, displayed as responsive, consistently-styled phone screen previews (3–5 images visible depending on viewport width).
Add the provided Smart Salon app icon image to the landing page branding and site metadata: use it as a visible brand mark in the hero area and as the site favicon/app icon.
Add basic SEO metadata using the provided Smart Salon description: set a meta description in the HTML head based on the user-provided short description.

Add a short deployment/domain guidance document explaining free hosting/domain options for the Smart Salon site on the Internet Computer (including the default free canister URL) and how a custom domain could be connected later.
Remove all references to coins, rewards, gamification, or any reward system from the entire landing page, including any icons, labels, feature cards, step descriptions, and marketing copy.

Replace the current About section paragraph and any other long-form descriptive copy with newly written short, clean, modern landing-page copy (English) that is suitable for a premium startup website and does not reuse the previously shared paragraph verbatim.

Update the Hero section copy to remove rewards-related wording while keeping a strong heading, short supporting text, and clear call-to-action buttons; ensure the hero layout looks premium with improved spacing, alignment, and typography.

Add a clean mobile app preview to the Hero section using the existing real app screenshots (do not introduce rewards-related imagery), presented as a premium phone-style preview alongside the hero text on desktop and stacked appropriately on mobile.

Create a clean header that displays the provided Smart Salon logo prominently and professionally, with correct sizing and spacing, and without distortion; do not replace the logo with other icons and do not generate a new logo.

Revise the Features section to show 3 or 4 feature cards with simple relevant icons and the following feature set only: Smart Booking, Owner Dashboard, Easy Management, Service Discovery; remove/replace any rewards-related or unrelated feature cards.
Revise the How It Works section to show 3 simple steps with icons, ensuring step titles/descriptions do not reference rewards and align with booking, scheduling, and management.

Keep the App Screens section using the real app screenshots, and refine presentation to a clean premium layout (grid or slider), maintaining consistent phone-preview styling and strong spacing on all screen sizes.

Apply page-wide UI polish: improve spacing, alignment, and typography across all sections; ensure consistent font sizing and hierarchy; use the specified dark premium theme colors consistently; maintain rounded cards, soft shadows, improved button styling, and mobile responsiveness.

Update SEO meta description in frontend/index.html to a newly written short, clean description that matches the updated no-rewards positioning (booking, scheduling, management) and does not reuse the previously shared paragraph verbatim.
Update the footer so the “Contact” link opens an in-app Contact view (page/section/modal) that displays the provided contact details and provides clickable actions.

Replace the current external “Privacy Policy” footer link with an in-app Privacy Policy view (page/section/modal) containing newly written English privacy policy content inspired by the user-shared privacy policy page (do not copy verbatim).
Implement an in-app Terms & Conditions view (page/section/modal) with newly written English terms content suitable for Smart Salon, and wire the footer “Terms” link to open it.
Remove the “7. Children's Privacy” section from the in-app Privacy Policy content so it no longer appears anywhere in the Privacy Policy modal.
Remove all Smart Salon app interface previews from the landing page, including the hero phone/app preview image and the entire “App Screens” section/grid that displays screenshots.

Update the landing page branding to use only the single user-provided Smart Salon logo (uploaded image) in the top corner/header, and remove any additional visible logo images elsewhere on the page (e.g., the footer brand logo). Do not generate a new logo and do not substitute with icons.

Adjust hero/above-the-fold typography and layout so key lines are slightly longer (avoid overly short, broken lines) while keeping a premium hierarchy and strong readability across common breakpoints.

Refine the formatting/layout of the lower portion of the landing page (below the main sections—CTA + footer area) to look more premium by improving spacing, alignment, and structure without adding new product features.
Deploy (publish) the current Smart Salon application to the Internet Computer using the existing deployment process, and provide the live canister URL(s) for preview.

Ensure user-facing site metadata remains brand-focused for Smart Salon and does not hardcode any canister URL into titles/descriptions intended for end users, so the site remains consistent when accessed via a custom domain like "smartsalon.com".

Diagnose and fix the current public landing-page URL returning “Error 400 — Canister ID Not Resolved” in Chrome by verifying the deployed frontend canister ID, confirming the correct gateway hostname format, and re-deploying the frontend if necessary so the site opens successfully via a stable public URL.

Update frontend/DEPLOYMENT.md to include step-by-step, registrar-agnostic instructions to connect the custom domain "smartsalonapp.com" to the deployed ICP frontend canister, including required DNS records, HTTPS considerations, and typical propagation timelines, and clearly state the final intended public URL as https://smartsalonapp.com.

Add brand-safe URL metadata for the custom domain by updating frontend/index.html to include a canonical URL and Open Graph URL that point to https://smartsalonapp.com, without hardcoding any canister URL into user-facing titles/descriptions.

Connect the custom domain "smartsalonapp.com" (and "www.smartsalonapp.com") to the already-deployed Internet Computer frontend canister and provide the final public URL(s) that should be used inside the Smart Salon mobile app.
Deploy the latest Smart Salon landing page build (the user-referenced “new version”) to the Internet Computer and provide the new public landing page URL(s) for preview.

Add a new section to the landing page titled "About App" that displays the exact text: "Smart Salon is a modern salon booking and management app designed for customers and salon owners. It allows users to book appointments, manage services, and streamline salon operations efficiently."

Make the "Get Started" button in the hero section fully clickable and functional: on click, display a simple "App Coming Soon" message (modal, toast, or alert) OR redirect to a placeholder page; ensure the button is not blocked by any overlaying elements (verify z-index and pointer-events are correctly set).

Apply the specified button styling to the "Get Started" button: background color #D4AF37 (gold), white text, medium border radius, and a soft shadow; ensure the styling is consistent and visually premium.

Add smooth interaction animations to the "Get Started" button: on hover, the button should slightly scale up (e.g., scale 1.05); on click, add a small press-down animation (e.g., brief scale reduction); ensure animations are smooth, subtle, and mobile-friendly.
